purpose: First explicit human-reviewed alias bindings for the Reef Guardian strategy review packet. Only aliases independently corroborated by existing high-confidence encounter evidence are accepted here; all other packet families remain pending.

decisions.rationale: Existing high-confidence Combat Alerts evidence for Reef Guardian explicitly identifies ability 166020 as Claw via TIMER_ALERTS_LEGACY.
Existing high-confidence Combat Alerts evidence for Reef Guardian explicitly identifies ability 166019 as Crush via TIMER_ALERTS_LEGACY.
Existing high-confidence Combat Alerts evidence for Reef Guardian explicitly identifies ability 165987 as Acid Pool via AOE_ALERTS, corroborating the repeated packet signature.
Existing high-confidence Combat Alerts evidence for Reef Guardian explicitly identifies ability 163701 as the Replication combat event.

Existing high-confidence Combat Alerts evidence records ability 166031 as the Heartburn Vulnerability success result; bind the numeric alias to the canonical Heartburn mechanic rather than treating the result effect as a separate mechanic identity.
